description: This file defines the EmailTemplate entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping it to the 'ohrm_email_template' database table with Doctrine ORM annotations. It includes properties for email template attributes such as id, email reference, locale, performer role, recipient role, subject, and body, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmailTemplate
classes.description: Entity class representing email templates with properties for id, email reference, locale, performer role, recipient role, subject, and body. It includes getters and setters for each property, mapped to the database via Doctrine annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the email template.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the email template.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale string, if set.

methods.name: getPerformerRole
methods.description: Returns the performer role string, if set.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the email template.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets the subject of the email template.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the body content of the email template.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the body content of the email template.
